focus: Idempotent portrait.json legacy migration under in-process concurrent load/save; one stable migrated project and active identity; malformed/current-library precedence; preservation of original files.

checks.observation: One process-wide static NSLock encloses both public load and save's loadWhileLocked path. The first caller reads portrait.json, constructs a single-project library, writes it, and returns only after the write succeeds. Subsequent callers read projects.json and retain that project's UUID and activeID.

checks.observation: A save replacing nil that acquires the lock while only legacy data exists first migrates it, then fails the comparison with staleSnapshot. If load acquires the lock first, that save observes the same already-migrated snapshot and fails. Neither ordering overwrites the migrated identity with a fresh candidate.

Sequential test compares first/reloaded library, checks v1 scene upgrade and original legacy bytes, then saves a renamed migrated record. Concurrent test uses 12 independently constructed stores, requires every returned snapshot to equal the persisted snapshot, and checks legacy bytes unchanged.
